verdict.rationale: Granola Chat is a built-in assistant that queries meetings across all notes, a single meeting or a folder. It can also act on your behalf: drafting and sending follow-up emails and Slack messages and creating Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. Saved recipes add reusable one-click prompts, and automatic follow-up drafts and pre-meeting briefs add proactive help. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-chat actions, and evidence of delegation beyond the three documented action types (email, Slack, Calendar).
